import struct
data = open('/app/alpine.iso','rb').read()

def parse_rec(off):
    rl = data[off]
    if rl==0: return None
    eal = data[off+1]
    ext = struct.unpack('<I', data[off+2:off+6])[0]
    fsz = struct.unpack('<I', data[off+6:off+10])[0]
    flags = data[off+25]
    nl = data[off+32]
    name = data[off+33:off+33+nl]
    return dict(rl=rl, ext=ext, size=fsz, flags=flags, name=name)

# Scan LBA 60..70 for directory records
for lba in range(58, 72):
    base = lba*2048
    o = base
    while o < base+2048:
        r = parse_rec(o)
        if r is None:
            o += 1
            continue
        # sanity: record length 33..512, name printable
        if 33 <= r['rl'] <= 512:
            nm = r['name']
            try:
                nms = nm.decode('ascii')
                if all(32<=c<127 for c in nms):
                    print(f"LBA {lba} off {o}: len={r['rl']} ext={r['ext']} size={r['size']} flags={r['flags']:02x} name={nms!r}")
            except: pass
        o += r['rl'] if 33<=r['rl']<=512 else 1

data = open('/app/alpine.iso','rb').read()

def rec_at(name_offset):
    name_len = data[name_offset-1]
    start = name_offset - 1 - 28
    length = data[start]
    eal = data[start+1]
